title: Profissionais lamentam não aprovação da lei de acesso à informação em STP
publisher: Rádio Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
why: No access to information law; a 2019 draft still unapproved (no-law and draft questions).

title: Universal Periodic Review (51st Session) Contribution of UNESCO to Compilation of UN information: Sao Tome and Principe
why: States there is no legislation on freedom of information and recommends an access to information law.

title: Universal Periodic Review 51st session: national report, Sao Tome and Principe
publisher: Government of Sao Tome and Principe (UN Human Rights Council)
why: Government says the Access to Public Information Act text is being drafted with partners; no law exists.

title: CIPSTP em Audiência com a Ministra da Justiça
publisher: Centro de Integridade Pública de STP
why: Civil society presented its draft access to information bill to the Minister of Justice.

title: Campanha de Advocacia sobre Corrupção em São Tomé e Príncipe
publisher: Centro de Integridade Pública de STP
why: States STP has no law on access to public and administrative information.

title: Formação da UNESCO Reforça Direito à Informação em STP
why: UNESCO training in October 2023 to support adopting an access to information law; none yet.

title: Redes de Boa Governação e de Jornalistas sensibilizam parlamentares sobre proposta de Lei de Acesso as Fontes de Informação
why: Draft access bill submitted to the National Assembly in 2018 lapsed; networks lobbying MPs in 2021.
